items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: My oldest brother and my brother Joy and myself.

ctx.x: And you picked it up more or less from your father then?

Well, yes. When my father, I remember he'd taken the three brothers up. My oldest brother and my brother Joy and myself. And he used to always see me fool around with the guitar. And so he got the three of us together and he showed us a little chord and everything. And it seemed like I was the one that kind of grasped the idea kind of quickly about the grappling of the chord. So, yeah, I remember the first number he showed me how to play was Go Feather Your Nest.
